title: OpenInGame
description: Click chat links to open them in Minecraft
body:
# Open In Game (OIG)
OpenInGame uses [MCEF](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcef) to add a new button to Minecraft’s links confirmation screen that lets you open a link inside your game without leaving.

When clicking a URL in chat, you’ll see an **Open in Game** option alongside the default buttons. Clicking it opens the website in a small in-game GUI instead of your browser.

## Dependencies
The mod currently requires MCEF
https://modrinth.com/mod/mcef
